supporting_pages.title: Create instances \_|\_ Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: For Cloud SQL Enterprise edition instances, Cloud SQL offers the general purpose shared core , general purpose dedicated core , and the N4 machine series.
For Cloud SQL Enterprise Plus edition instances, Cloud SQL offers predefined machine types for your instances in the N2 and C4A machine series.
